researchQuestion: With the Main Reactor fixed at 6 Space and centered on PF4 -1/PF4/PF4 +1, when should the 2-Space Auxiliary Power Unit mature from +1 to +2 Operational TP, is a late +3 TP step viable, and does unrestricted APU stacking remain self-limiting in both power economics and distributed-power resilience?

stackingPolicy.purpose: Keep unrestricted stacking legal during calibration. A count cap may be recommended only if the fixed 2-Space economics or distributed-power resilience create an exploit.

resiliencePolicy.purpose: Measure deterministic retained-power consequences of losing one or more independent APU units without inventing new higher-TL degraded-output mechanics before the Operational trajectory is selected.

combatComparison: Matched legal one-Main-Reactor carrier with N 2-Space APUs versus the identical carrier with zero APUs, mirrored. Only candidate Operational APU TP differs in the research combat kernel; remaining Space is mission/noncombat capacity.
expectedStudyProducts: APU trajectory ledger for flat +1 and TL5/TL6/TL7/TL8 +2 maturation
sparse 2-Space/+3 TP late boundary probes at TL8 and TL9
PF4-1/PF4/PF4+1 interaction surfaces at fixed 6-Space Main Reactor
exact legal unrestricted APU stack support at fixed 2-Space footprint
player-base-cruiser APU fit limits by TL
stochastic doctrine response for 1/2/3/MAX APU stacks
matched full-map combat response for the unique TL-local APU outputs
trajectory-level stochastic and combat summaries without automatic promotion
